title: Majorization conjecture for products of positive semidefinite matrices
statement:
Let $A$ and $B$ be $n\times n$ positive semidefinite matrices. Let $\lambda(X)$ denote the vector of eigenvalues of a Hermitian matrix $X$, arranged in decreasing order, and let $\succ$ denote majorization. **Majorization conjecture.**

$$
\lambda(A^2+|BA|^p)\succ\lambda(A^2+|AB|^p)\quad\text{for all }p>0.
$$

If true, this would imply the corresponding determinant inequality for all positive $p$ and would extend the known cases discussed immediately beforehand. The source reports numerical evidence but leaves the majorization statement as a question.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1604.04141

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of April 2016).
source_name: Minghua Lin, “On a determinantal inequality arising from diffusion tensor imaging”, arXiv:1604.04141 (2016).
